messages:
Hannah: quick heads-up  seeing mismatch between client-side telemetry and console sparklines for tenant-pegasus. console shows 1m buckets with spikes, our py client flushes every 7s so numbers look off.
Omar: any headers in the captured requests? sounds familiar.
Hannah: sample (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  X-Telemetry-Sample: 0.01
  X-Telemetry-Window: 7s
  Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
```
Priya: server canonicalizes tenant windows to 60s. we do that to keep multi-client reporting sane. the problem: we never feed the canonical value back to clients, so local batching keeps using 7s and console rebuckets to 60s -> visual noise.
Ken: options: (A) server remains authoritative and ignore client hints in console (fast), (B) server emits X-Effective-Telemetry-Window in responses and clients adopt it (longer, correct), (C) SDK opt-in env var to follow server immediately.
Omar: (B)+(C) seems right. server adds response header on handshake; SDKs read and optionally adopt if env var set to true. avoids sudden changes for older clients.
Hannah: can we also have console add an annotation when a client version flips to server-driven windowing? would help correlate spikes.
Priya: yep. propose client emits a one-off telemetry event when it switches: client.telemetry_change {from: "7s", to: "60s", reason: "server-handshake"}. console can show a small marker on the sparkline.
Ken: small SDK change for py/ts/go: after first successful request, read resp.headers["X-Effective-Telemetry-Window"], if present and os.env("REDWOOD_USE_SERVER_TELEMETRY") == "true" then update local batching window and emit event. fallback if header absent: no-op.
Omar: server PR will add header to /v1/handshake and /v1/generate responses when tenant policy differs from client hint. also add a metric counting how many clients adopt the server window.
Hannah: short-term: console smoothing patch to merge spikes shorter than tenant_window/2 so dashboards don't look noisy during rollout.
Ken: testing plan: unit tests for header parsing in SDKs, e2e with staging tenant, console visual diff.
Priya: rollout plan: server headers -> staging tomorrow; console smoothing + annotation -> next patch; py/ts/go beta SDKs with env opt-in next week; monitor and flip default in SDKs after two weeks of stable telemetry.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: server/telemetry-handshake v2026.06.10-04:00 UTC -> staging
Hannah: assigning tasks: Omar server PR, Ken python+go PRs, Priya console smoothing/annotation. I'll coordinate telemetry dashboards and gather tenant repros.
Omar: ack, will include migration guide note: "Clients may opt-in to server-driven telemetry via REDWOOD_USE_SERVER_TELEMETRY=true".
Ken: will keep change < 40 LOC per SDK. aim for beta build by EOD next Friday.
Priya: I'll add console unit tests and QA the before/after visuals. will ping here when screenshots available :thumbsup:
